# Rust 2026 Template

> A production-ready Rust workspace template with modern tooling, CI/CD, and AI agent integration.
>
> For complete source context, see llms-full.txt

## Project Overview

This is a comprehensive Rust workspace template designed for 2026 best practices. It includes:
- Multi-crate workspace structure
- Integrated testing with nextest and proptest
- Quality gates and CI/CD pipelines
- AI agent skills and documentation
- Security scanning and dependency auditing

## Architecture

```
rust-2026-template/
├── .agents/skills/          # AI agent skill definitions (canonical workflows)
├── .cargo/config.toml       # Cargo linker + profile config
├── .config/nextest.toml     # nextest profiles
├── .github/workflows/       # CI/CD GitHub Actions
├── scripts/                 # Development and quality scripts
├── plans/adr/               # Architecture Decision Records
├── crates/                  # Workspace member crates
│   ├── example-crate/       # Library crate example
│   └── sample-app/          # Binary application example
├── examples/                # Example projects
├── tests/                   # Integration tests
├── AGENTS.md                # Canonical AI agent guidance
├── Cargo.toml               # Workspace manifest
└── README.md                # Project documentation
```

## Key Files

### Documentation
- `README.md` - Project overview and quick start
- `AGENTS.md` - Canonical AI agent coding guidelines
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` - Contribution guidelines
- `QUICKSTART.md` - Quick start guide
- `CHANGELOG.md` - Version history
- `SECURITY.md` - Security policy

### Configuration
- `Cargo.toml` - Workspace manifest and dependencies
- `rust-toolchain.toml` - Rust toolchain version
- `rustfmt.toml` - Code formatting rules
- `.clippy.toml` - Clippy linting configuration
- `deny.toml` - Cargo deny configuration
- `ci-summary.md` - Current CI health status for all jobs
- `.agents/metrics.jsonl` - Agentic task completion history
- `benchmarks/history.jsonl` - Performance benchmark history

### AI Agent Skills
- `.agents/skills/build-rust/` - Optimized build procedures
- `.agents/skills/lint-rust/` - Formatting and static analysis
- `.agents/skills/test-rust/` - Comprehensive testing workflows
- `.agents/skills/release-rust/` - Safe crate release process
- `.agents/skills/anti-ai-slop/` - Auditing generic AI patterns
- `.agents/skills/privacy-first/` - PII prevention
- `.agents/skills/crates-io-name-check/` - Registry verification

## Development Commands

### Build
```bash
cargo build --workspace
```

### Quality Checks
```bash
./scripts/code-quality.sh fmt      # Format code
./scripts/code-quality.sh clippy   # Run linter
./scripts/code-quality.sh audit    # Security audit
./scripts/code-quality.sh check    # All checks
```

### Testing
```bash
cargo nextest run --workspace      # Run all tests
cargo test --doc                   # Run doc tests
```

### Quality Gates
```bash
./scripts/quality-gates.sh         # Run all quality gates
```

### Release
```bash
./scripts/release-manager.sh       # Interactive release manager
```

## Code Conventions

- **File Size:** Max 500 LOC per source file
- **Lints:** Zero clippy warnings allowed
- **Safety:** `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` enforced
- **Error Handling:** `thiserror` for libraries, `anyhow` for binaries
- **Testing:** Use `proptest` for pure functions, `tokio::test` for async
- **Documentation:** All public items require `///` doc comments

## Workflow

1. **Discover:** Read existing code patterns
2. **Plan:** Identify affected files and test coverage
3. **Test-First:** Add/update tests before implementation (TDD)
4. **Implement:** Write code following conventions
5. **Quality Check:** Run fmt, clippy, tests, quality gates
6. **Commit:** Use conventional commit format

## Required Checks Before Submit

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --tests -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo build --workspace`
- [ ] `cargo nextest run --workspace`
- [ ] `./scripts/quality-gates.sh`
- [ ] Consult `ci-summary.md` for current CI health
